snippet.description:

Twitter: 👉  https://bit.ly/3fdOUFK
Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

https://www.gog.com/game/robbo_millennium

Yes, yes - it's HIM! Your favorite - the legendary Robbo!
The iconic video game hero is back in action and once again has to collect screws!
This time, however, it's not so easy, because they are scattered across over 135 planets!
Without your help, it's probably impossible...
- A legendary hero in new adventures!
- Two sets of levels – over 135 planets in total!
- Lots of puzzles, surprises and great fun!
- New graphics, music and visuals!
- Proven atmosphere and excellent playability!
Rest assured, even though it’s not easy, all the planets can be completed.
Are you ready for the challenge?
